festivals.what: Yamaguchi Gion Festival (Yasaka Shrine, Yamaguchi City): 20 to 27 July (2026 listing); the procession with the heron dance (sagi no mai) on the 20th, a citizens' dance on the 24th and the return of the deity on the 27th.

culture-cycles.note: Dates from the shrine, city or tourism body's own page, read directly 2026-11-05.
